thread:
Alex: Quick weekly pulse — heads-up on the release train for v3.7. We're doing a traffic rebalance for inference and embeddings routes this morning.
Maya: Canary started @ 09:00 UTC. Early metric: small latency spike on embeddings-infer (~+45ms p95) starting at ~09:12.
Sahil: Confirmed. Kernel-side queuing on canary GPU hosts 4-7. I'm rolling a rollback of the quant-plugin on canary nodes now.
Sahil: Command I'm running:
```
kubectl -n canary rollout undo deployment/quant-plugin --to-revision=12
```
deploy-bot: [09:18 UTC] Canary deploy v3.7.2 -> rollout-status: 3/3 pods ready. No crashloop detected. (link: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/789)
Maya: After rollback the p95 dropped back toward baseline within 3m. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/ingress/embeddings — watch the red clusters.
Lisa: Because this impacted inference latency briefly, we're instituting a temporary release freeze for the train: 10:00–12:00 UTC. Hold non-critical deploys and feature flags that change routing. If you need an exemption, ping me + provide test plan.
Alex: Plan: monitor for 1 hour post-fix, then resume a gradual rollout with reduced concurrency. Priority: avoid cascade retries on client side.
Maya: Added short changelog items: - quant-plugin rollback on canary, - traffic rebalance for embeddings-infer, - temporary release freeze 10-12 UTC. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/eng/release-notes/456
Sahil: Running 60m load/heat test now, will post final readout. If anything flares, we'll abort resume and extend freeze.
Alex: Thanks everyone — status updates here please. :thumbsup:
